findings.note: UNAVOIDABLE AND REPORTED. Deterministic resolution is a lookup on the linkage table, so any query that must resolve has to use a code the table contains - there is no code outside it that could resolve to anything. The consequence is precise: **resolution accuracy on either retrieval set measures the table's self-consistency, not whether resolution generalises.** It is not evidence that resolution works on codes nobody curated. Ranking quality is unaffected, because the ranking target is the section, which the linkage table says nothing about.
